about: Hand mapping by ProofNotFluff, Oct 27, 2026, from the City's own violation codes and descriptions. A violation code listed here goes to its trade; any other code in the City's EV (elevator), BR (boiler), VT (ventilation), RF (refrigeration), PL (plumbing) or EL (electrical) code series goes to the matching trade; everything else is not counted by trade.

trades.label: Masonry
trades.who: Exterior walls, parapets and coping, chimneys, lintels, sills, cornices and foundations.

trades.label: Porches and exterior stairs
trades.who: Porch systems, exterior stairs and balconies, including porches the City lists as dangerous and hazardous.

trades.label: Electrical and detectors
trades.who: Wiring, outlets, fixtures, service and grounding from the electrical code, plus smoke and carbon monoxide detectors.

trades.label: Heating, boilers and ventilation
trades.who: Boilers and water heaters, ventilation, refrigeration systems, and heat that is missing or not adequate.

trades.label: Elevators and lifts
trades.who: Electric and hydraulic elevators, escalators, wheelchair and platform lifts, dumbwaiters and hoists.

trades.label: Plumbing
trades.who: Leaks, hot and cold water, drains and sewer connections, fixtures, catch basins and work that needs a licensed plumbing contractor.
